_doc: skill -> { tiers: { fast|balanced|deep: { modelKey OR (provider+model), ...extras } }, maxOutputTokens, dailyTokenQuota }. modelKey references data/llm-models-cache.json (Notion-synced) with config/llm-config.json fallback — resolves provider, model id, baseUrl, apiKeyEnv from the shared registry. Legacy inline `provider`+`model` still supported for models not in registry (e.g. opus). Explicit binding fields override resolved values.

invoice-enrich.classify._doc: PDF text pre-extracted via pdftotext before prompt build (no Read tool needed). balanced=anthropic-cli (subscription, allowedTools kept for legacy no-op); deep=deepseek-api fallback when CLI session/login unavailable (L1/L4 deny) — independent API key, text-only prompt.

nexus.chat._doc: Phase 4: catch-all chat skill for src/app/llm/client.ts. Tier name encodes Nexus tier (budget/standard/analysis) — client.ts:selectModel passes the tier label here, gateway resolves provider+model via binding. Caller-supplied model overrides binding via authzResult passthrough.

crawler.login._doc: One-time helper for user to login Facebook/Telegram in the CloakBrowser profile. Opens headed browser, waits ~5 min for manual login, closes. Run manually via npm run login:fb / login:tg. Extremely low volume — few calls/month total.

crawler.join._doc: Crawler Facebook/Telegram group-join check via CloakBrowser MCP. Cheap: 5-30s + few browser tool calls per channel. Runs ~10-30 channels/day per feature (artist/dev/qaqc/gd) → conservative daily quota. Default Haiku 4.5 primary + Sonnet 4.6 fallback (2026-07-07): gateway-runner auto-retry deep tier khi Haiku fail JSON parse. Force pure Haiku via caller fallbackTier=null; force Sonnet always via NEXUS_AI_GATEWAY_MODEL_CRAWLER_JOIN=claude-sonnet-4-6.

crawler.extract._doc: Crawler post/profile extraction from FB Group/Telegram/Upwork/Fiverr/LinkedIn/Diễn đàn VN via CloakBrowser MCP. 5-30s + browser interaction per keyword-channel pair. High-volume — 4 features × 5 batches × N channels × M keywords. Default Haiku 4.5 primary + Sonnet 4.6 fallback (2026-07-07): gateway-runner tự retry với deep tier khi Haiku fail JSON parse (Haiku thường prose preamble). Force pure Haiku via caller fallbackTier=null; force Sonnet always via NEXUS_AI_GATEWAY_MODEL_CRAWLER_EXTRACT=claude-sonnet-4-6.

sensitive-audit.classify._doc: Tier 2 detector for sensitive-data audit. 1 LLM call per ambiguous page/file (regex confidence 0.55-0.7). Daily scope: up to MAX_NOTION_PAGES + MAX_DRIVE_FILES (500+500=1000). Conservative quota (1M tokens/day) covers worst case.

sensitive-classifier.classify._doc: Runtime query classifier used after keyword pre-filter in src/app/llm/sensitive-classifier.ts. API-key Haiku keeps this off subscription budget; use NEXUS_AI_GATEWAY_MODEL_SENSITIVE_CLASSIFIER_CLASSIFY for runtime model override.

feedback-app.analyze._doc: Read-only feedback issue analysis for src/app/schedulers/acenexus/feedback-app-processor.ts. Routes Codex subscription usage through ai-gateway; codex-cli adapter enforces read-only sandbox.

model-health.ping._doc: Tiny model availability smoke test used by model registry health checks. Callers may pass modelOverride to test a specific provider/model/apiKeyEnv through gateway gates.
